note: The committed detection level the CI gate protects (plan §5.3). The scorer fails a run whose recall drops below `metrics.recall` or whose false-positive count rises above `metrics.fp_count`. Bump this deliberately, in the same commit as the rule/ruleset change that improves detection, so the metric move is a reviewable diff — never let it drift silently (ADR: intentional improvement updates the baseline).
